definitions.explanation: The involuntary opening of the mouth wide with a deep breath, typically when tired or bored.

examples.japanese: {眠|ねむ}くて{欠伸|あくび}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: I'm sleepy and can't stop yawning.

examples.japanese: {会議中|かいぎちゅう}に{欠伸|あくび}をするのは{失礼|しつれい}だ。
examples.english: It's rude to yawn during a meeting.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{欠伸|あくび}をしてしまった。
examples.english: I let out a big yawn.

examples.japanese: {欠伸|あくび}は{伝染|でんせん}すると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Yawns are said to be contagious.

notes:
KANJI: Usually written in hiragana as あくび. The kanji {欠伸|あくび} is rarely used.

VERB USAGE:
・{欠伸|あくび}をする (to yawn - suru-verb form)
・{欠伸|あくび}が{出|で}る (to yawn - "a yawn comes out")
・{欠伸|あくび}を{噛|か}み{殺|ころ}す (to stifle a yawn)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{大|おお}きな{欠伸|あくび} - a big yawn
・{生|なま}{欠伸|あくび} - yawning (continuous/repeated)
・{欠伸|あくび}を{我慢|がまん}する - to hold back a yawn

RELATED INVOLUNTARY BODY ACTIONS:
・くしゃみ - sneeze
・しゃっくり - hiccup
・げっぷ - burp
